mcqs.keyword: Deity, architectural style and historical patronage
mcqs.question:
With reference to the Sri Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple at Simhachalam, match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) Deity
(b) Architectural style
(c) Patronage
(d) Inscriptions

List-II
(i) Sri Krishnadevaraya
(ii) Kalinga style
(iii) Combined Varaha and Narasimha
(iv) Kulottunga Chola
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is a-iii, b-ii, c-iv and d-i: the deity is a combination of Varaha and Narasimha, the temple follows the Kalinga style, it received the patronage of Kulottunga Chola, and its inscriptions include those of Sri Krishnadevaraya. The tempting option a-ii, b-iii, c-i, d-iv wrongly interchanges all four associations.

mcqs.question: Kurnool served as the capital of Andhra State during which period?
mcqs.explanation: Kurnool was the capital of Andhra State from 1953 to 1956. April 20, 2026 is associated with the Simhachalam Chandanotsavam, while April 23 marks Maharshi Bhagiratha Jayanti and February 7, 2024 marks the end of the previous PCPNDT Board term.
